about: The migrator wrote its copies but no record file. `record` exits 1 with one line naming the record file, and nothing changes: the run stays at migrating, batch 1, round 0, and the notes keep the migrator's writes, so the session can retry the migrator. The open run has no fixing key, as after start (cases 64 and 72). The runner can't check that no verify-b1-r0.json was written.
